page.notes: The table is a calendar with the Hebrew month names (Tisri, Cisleu, Tebeth, Schebet, Adar, Veadar, Scheet, Mar.) and the Roman month names as column heads. The row numbers 1 to 19 sit in the leftmost column. The first table cell of the header row is blank. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side lies below the table and is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "Scheet" (Feb. 15, 27) and "Schebet" forms may be printed with variant spellings; the Hebrew month names are transcribed in Latin letters as printed.
